source.name: azure-boards
source.fetch: az boards query --wiql "SELECT [System.Id], [System.Title] FROM workitems WHERE [System.Tags] CONTAINS 'navi-delivery' AND [System.State] <> 'Closed'" --output json | jq '[.[] | {id: ("AB-" + (.fields."System.Id"|tostring)), title: .fields."System.Title"}]'

pr.command: az repos pr create --source-branch "$NAVI_BRANCH" --target-branch "$NAVI_BASE" --title "$NAVI_ITEM_TITLE" --description "Proposed by navi-cron from $NAVI_ITEM_ID. Nothing in this branch has been reviewed by a person." --output none
